# Extra packages installed only when the action's `e2e-runtime` input is
# true, AFTER packages-build.txt in a separate apt transaction (as before the
# lists moved out of action.yml). One per line; `#` starts a comment.
#
# The Vulkan ICDs (mesa-vulkan-drivers) are deliberately NOT in
# packages-build.txt: llvmpipe is not a faithful substitute for the real GPU
# in the gpu_pipeline lib tests, which rely on adapter-construction failure to
# self-skip, and a software ICD silently flips that skip off.
weston
xwayland
libgl1-mesa-dri
mesa-vulkan-drivers
libegl1
